newsitem.title: GERMANY: Daimler-Benz no comment on board meeting.
newsitem.headline: Daimler-Benz no comment on board meeting.

text.p: Germany's Daimler-Benz AG said on Wednesday it was making no comment on reports that its board was due to meet later in the day to discuss its chief executive Juergen Schrempp plans for a management shake-up.
A Daimler spokesman said talks over a planned internal restructuring of the company, which it has earlier confirmed is likely also to lead to board changes, were continuing.
"There is no time pressure on coming to a decision on this matter," he added.

German media reports have focused on the supposed opposition of Helmut Werner, chairman of Daimler's Mercedes subsidiary, to plans thought to concentrate more power in the hands of the central Daimler group management.
A number of reports repeated a suggestion, previously denied by Daimler, that Werner would be offered a top position within the new Daimler board.
